what_happened: Dispatching the librarian for the MiniMax-H3/Kaggle research failed immediately with: Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media. No research was returned.
root_cause: Recurring librarian session/context failure (same error seen previously on the quota-reset research). The librarian agent session cannot be compacted within the model context limit, so it errors before doing work.
impact: Research had to be performed directly by the orchestrator via webfetch. One wasted dispatch.
corrective_action: Treat librarian as unreliable for this environment; prefer direct webfetch for bounded research, or investigate the librarian agent context configuration (system prompt/skills size) causing the compaction failure.
